rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for a brief, unspecified period, as in waiting a moment.

example.english: Wait a moment for me first.

rows.note: Use 份量 for importance expressed as influence, standing, or figurative weight rather than abstract importance.

example.english: Their opinion carries a lot of moment in the company.
example.traditional: 佢嘅意見喺公司好有份量。
example.jyutping: keoi5 ge3 ji3 gin3 hai2 gung1 si1 hou2 jau5 fan6 loeng6

rows.note: Use 重要性 when stating the abstract importance of something instead of the more figurative 份量.

example.english: I understand that this matter is of great moment.
example.traditional: 我明白呢件事嘅重要性。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ming4 baak6 ni1 gin6 si6 ge3 zung6 jiu3 sing3
